# Electrocution

Electrocution is a neo-brutalist theme recorded for both dark and light modes, built on heavy black borders, offset shadows and an accent palette of hot pink, acid lime, ultraviolet purple, cyan and warning yellow. Its README lists bordered task cards with oversized checkboxes, loud tags with animated hover states, color-coded note, tip, warning and danger callouts, neon syntax highlighting on black code blocks, and styled properties and frontmatter panels. It states that Reading view and Live Preview are styled to match.

![Electrocution screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monapdx/Electrocution/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Electrocution"
    author: "Ashly Lorenzana"
    repo:   "monapdx/Electrocution"
    slug:   "electrocution"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/electrocution"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/monapdx/Electrocution"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monapdx/Electrocution/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
}
```
